about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/std: edits of the std sources (the .ergo declarations and the Go that reads them) that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/std; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded by ESC1 (wf10, lang audit B F1).

mutants.name: esc1-timeout-nonescaping
mutants.from: f escaping func() A fails E needs R
mutants.to: f func() A fails E needs R
mutants.rule: A joined child task is not the caller's task: a timeout callback cannot borrow a caller-owned Set.

mutants.name: esc1-transform-nonescaping
mutants.rule: types.md, Function values 2: a callback that runs on other tasks at the same time is escaping, so the capture rule refuses a write to the caller's let mut (lang audit B F1, probe race).

mutants.name: esc1-feed-nonescaping
mutants.from: run escaping func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.to: run func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.rule: std.ArgClauses: a Go body's parameter clause matches its review; ActorFeed runs run on a task of its own after feed returned.

mutants.name: dense-optof-drops-id
mutants.rule: OptOf holds the id it was made of.

mutants.name: dense-or-misreads-none
mutants.rule: Or gives the default only for none, never for the first id.

mutants.name: dense-unpack-misreads-none
mutants.rule: Unpack is None only for none.

mutants.name: dense-index-off-by-one
mutants.rule: Index is the position of the row: 0 for the first row put.

mutants.name: dense-next-skips-zero
mutants.rule: The id of a store that holds n rows is n: ids are dense from 0.

mutants.name: dense-has-includes-end
mutants.from: func Has[T](t Table[T], id ID[T]) bool { int(id.n) < len(t.rows) }
mutants.to: func Has[T](t Table[T], id ID[T]) bool { int(id.n) <= len(t.rows) }
mutants.rule: Has is false for an id one past the end.

mutants.name: dense-put-copies
mutants.rule: Put appends in amortized constant space (Dense stores 4): a Put that copies the table grows quadratically.

mutants.name: dense-put-drops-row
mutants.rule: Put appends the row it names.

mutants.name: dense-at-through-get
mutants.from: func At[T](t Table[T], id ID[T]) T { t.rows[int(id.n)] }
mutants.rule: At lowers to a slice index with no call (Dense stores 4).

mutants.name: dense-at-reads-first
mutants.from: func At[T](t Table[T], id ID[T]) T { t.rows[int(id.n)] }
mutants.to: func At[T](t Table[T], id ID[T]) T { t.rows[0] }
mutants.rule: At reads the row its id names.

mutants.name: dense-get-includes-end
mutants.rule: Get is None for an id past the end, never a defect.

mutants.name: dense-set-writes-first
mutants.rule: Set writes the row its id names.

mutants.name: dense-each-ids-shifted
mutants.rule: Each gives each row with its own id.

mutants.name: dense-each-ignores-stop
mutants.rule: Each stops when its yield returns false.

mutants.name: dense-ids-skips-first
mutants.rule: IDs gives every id from 0.

mutants.name: dense-ids-ignores-stop
mutants.rule: IDs stops when its yield returns false.

mutants.name: dense-rows-drops-last
mutants.rule: Rows is every row in id order.

mutants.name: dense-idof-shifted
mutants.rule: IDOf is the id of position i.

mutants.name: dense-next-no-advance
mutants.rule: Next makes a fresh id each call.

mutants.name: dense-total-off-by-one
mutants.rule: Total is the count of ids Next made.

mutants.name: dense-push-twice
mutants.rule: Push appends one value: the column stays as long as its Count.

mutants.name: dense-in-includes-end
mutants.from: func In[K, V](c Col[K, V], id ID[K]) bool { int(id.n) < len(c.xs) }
mutants.to: func In[K, V](c Col[K, V], id ID[K]) bool { int(id.n) <= len(c.xs) }
mutants.rule: In is false for an id past the column's end.

mutants.name: dense-of-reads-first
mutants.from: func Of[K, V](c Col[K, V], id ID[K]) V { c.xs[int(id.n)] }
mutants.to: func Of[K, V](c Col[K, V], id ID[K]) V { c.xs[0] }
mutants.rule: Of reads the value its id names.

mutants.name: dense-setof-writes-first
mutants.rule: SetOf writes the value its id names.

mutants.name: dense-sideof-hides-last
mutants.rule: SideOf reads every id set, the last one too.

mutants.name: dense-sideset-fills-value
mutants.rule: An id never set holds the default, even below one set.

mutants.name: dense-sideset-short
mutants.rule: SideSet grows the column to hold its id.

mutants.name: dense-putlist-starts-at-zero
mutants.rule: A run starts where its list was put: a later list does not overlap an earlier one.

mutants.name: dense-putlist-short-run
mutants.rule: A run is as long as its list.

mutants.name: dense-list-from-zero
mutants.rule: List reads its own run.

mutants.name: dense-items-halved
mutants.rule: Items counts every item of every list.

mutants.name: dense-runlen-off-by-one
mutants.rule: RunLen is the count of items of its run.

mutants.name: dense-len-off-by-one
mutants.rule: Len is the count of rows.

mutants.name: dense-intern-forgets
mutants.rule: Intern finds a value interned before: interning is a bijection between values seen and ids.

mutants.name: dense-intern-value-first
mutants.from: func Value[T comparable](s Interner[T], id ID[T]) T { s.rows[int(id.n)] }
mutants.to: func Value[T comparable](s Interner[T], id ID[T]) T { s.rows[0] }
mutants.rule: Value is the value interned under its id.

mutants.name: dense-lookup-never-finds
mutants.rule: Lookup finds an interned value.

mutants.name: dense-interned-off-by-one
mutants.from: func Interned[T comparable](s Interner[T]) int { len(s.rows) }
mutants.to: func Interned[T comparable](s Interner[T]) int { len(s.rows) + 1 }
mutants.rule: Interned is the count of distinct values.

mutants.name: dense-strings-compares-only-hash
mutants.rule: FindText compares the text, not only its hash slot: the first id in the probe sequence is not always the text.

mutants.name: dense-strings-tail-first
mutants.rule: Text of a waiting text reads its own place in the short list.

mutants.name: dense-strings-settle-from-zero
mutants.rule: A settled text's offsets start after the texts settled before it.

mutants.name: dense-texts-counts-offsets
mutants.rule: Texts is the count of distinct texts: two offsets per settled text.

mutants.name: dense-strings-spans-chained
mutants.rule: Settling appends its offsets in amortized constant space; a chained Append copies the offsets each time (Dense stores 4).

mutants.name: dense-counted-add-forgets
mutants.rule: Add of a live value gives its id, never a new one.

mutants.name: dense-counted-frees-at-one
mutants.rule: Release frees an id only when its count falls to 0.

mutants.name: dense-counted-never-reuses
mutants.rule: A new value takes a freed id before a new one.

mutants.name: dense-counted-use-counts-nothing
mutants.rule: Use counts one more holder.

mutants.name: dense-counted-member-first
mutants.from: func Member[T comparable](c Counted[T], id ID[T]) T { c.rows[int(id.n)] }
mutants.to: func Member[T comparable](c Counted[T], id ID[T]) T { c.rows[0] }
mutants.rule: Member is the value its id names.

mutants.name: dense-counted-live-counts-slots
mutants.from: func Live[T comparable](c Counted[T]) int { len(c.ids) }
mutants.to: func Live[T comparable](c Counted[T]) int { len(c.rows) }
mutants.rule: Live counts the values in the set, not the ids made.

mutants.name: dense-sparse-contains-trusts-index
mutants.rule: Contains checks that the member at its index is the id: a stale index does not make a member.

mutants.name: dense-sparse-remove-loses-last
mutants.rule: Remove moves the last member and its index into the removed one's place.

mutants.name: dense-sparse-insert-twice
mutants.rule: Insert of a member leaves the set as it is: Members holds each member once.

mutants.name: dense-sparse-clear-keeps
mutants.rule: Clear removes every member.

mutants.name: dense-sparse-size-off-by-one
mutants.rule: Size is the count of members.

mutants.name: dense-counted-find-never-finds
mutants.rule: Find finds a live value's id.

mutants.name: dense-counted-free-id-stale
mutants.rule: A reused id takes its new value.

mutants.name: dense-strings-settles-every-text
mutants.rule: Waiting texts are joined onto the one string only when they hold as many bytes as it, so each byte is copied a bounded number of times (Dense stores 4).

mutants.name: stdsh-trimleft-binding
mutants.rule: stdlib.md strings 10: TrimLeft binds Go's TrimLeft (law TrimLeftRightKeepEnds).

mutants.name: stdsh-builder-write
mutants.rule: stdlib.md strings 10: a Builder's text is its writes in order (law BuilderConcatenates).

mutants.name: stdsh-max-binding
mutants.rule: stdlib.md cmp: Max is the larger value (law MaxMinSplit).
